segments.speaker: Maya - Account Executive
segments.text:
Derek,

Recap from today: 42 named users, 3 admin seats, calibration records import for the last 24 months, and go-live target of May 6.

Standard annual subscription is $46,800, implementation is $7,500 one-time. Net 30, 12-month initial term.

I can send the order form if that lines up.

Maya

segments.speaker: Derek - Quality Operations
segments.text:
Maya,

Functionally yes. The issue is the first-year number. I have $40k approved for software and services combined, and finance will not reopen it until June.

If we can fit under that, I can get signature this week.

Derek

segments.speaker: Maya - Account Executive
segments.text:
Derek,

Per our messages last night, let's lock the 42 users plus the import at $39,600 total for year 1. That is below the pricing sheet and I do not have the concession approved in the CRM or through deal desk yet, but I don't want the official route to slow this down when your go-live is already tight. Reply approved here and I will move the order form at $39,600 today, then I'll clean up the internal approval and paperwork after the fact.

Maya

segments.speaker: Derek - Quality Operations
segments.text:
Approved on $39,600 total for year 1, 42 users, import included.

Please send the order form today. Our controller needs the invoice to reference PO 11873 and the cost center QA-410.

Derek

segments.speaker: Maya - Account Executive
segments.text:
Attached order form is updated.

Details:
- 42 named users
- 3 admin seats included in the 42
- Calibration history import up to 24 months
- Remote implementation, 4 working sessions
- Target production date May 6
- Invoice references PO 11873 and QA-410

segments.speaker: Derek - Quality Operations
segments.text:
Thanks. Two edits before I route:

1. Our legal template requires 30 days' notice for non-renewal, not 60.
2. We need one invoice after signature, not split subscription/services.

Can you revise those?

segments.speaker: Maya - Account Executive
segments.text:
Yes. Revised attached.

Non-renewal notice is now 30 days. Billing is one invoice after countersignature, net 30.

No change to scope or dates.

Maya

segments.speaker: Derek - Quality Operations
segments.text:
Looks good. Sending to our VP of Quality and finance now.

Assuming both sign today, can your implementation lead join our kickoff on Apr 18 at 10:00 Central?

segments.speaker: Maya - Account Executive
segments.text:
Yes, Apr 18 at 10:00 Central works. I put a soft hold on our side.

Once the signed order form is back, I'll introduce Priya from implementation and send the import template for the asset list, gage IDs, due dates, and current cert attachments.

Maya

segments.speaker: Derek - Quality Operations
segments.text:
Signed copy attached.

Derek
